42624300.title: From protection to progression: How CCT/TRiC shapes therapy-induced senescence in Glioblastoma multiforme.
42624300.journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease
42624300.what: 研究脑瘤中一种蛋白复合物如何影响治疗诱导的细胞衰老，可能影响肿瘤复发。
42624300.why: 为脑瘤治疗策略提供新思路，但与直接抗衰老药关联较弱。

42632547.title: Immunopharmacological reprogramming of innate immune memory in Alzheimer's disease: From microglial priming to therapeutic resilience.
42632547.what: 综述阿尔茨海默病中免疫记忆重编程，提及多种药物调节小胶质细胞功能。
42632547.why: 抗衰老药如二甲双胍、雷帕霉素等被提及，具转化潜力。

42627589.title: Systemic and local dysregulation of the complement system in glioma: a comprehensive systematic review.
42627589.journal: Clinical & translational oncology : official publication of the Federation of Spanish Oncology Societies and of the National Cancer Institute of Mexico
42627589.what: 系统回顾补体系统在胶质瘤中的异常，主要涉及肿瘤免疫逃逸。
42627589.why: 聚焦肿瘤机制，与抗衰老直接关联不大。

42632465.title: Exercise and p21 signaling in central nervous system aging and senescence: A context- and dose-dependent relationship.
42632465.what: 运动与衰老相关蛋白p21的关系，发现运动可减少或增加p21取决于情况。
42632465.why: 提示运动作为抗衰老干预的复杂性，常规进展。

42640108.title: Decoding the multidimensional landscape of skin aging: molecular pathways and next-generation diagnostics & therapeutics.
42640108.what: 综述皮肤衰老的分子机制及下一代诊断和治疗方法。
42640108.why: 皮肤衰老是抗衰老领域热点，但多为综述，无新药。

42624351.title: Aging as cross-hallmark obstruction amplification: A sheaf-theoretic model of repair closure, senescence, inflammation, and regenerative failure.
42624351.what: 用数学模型解释衰老过程中修复能力丧失，涉及多个衰老标志。
42624351.why: 纯理论建模，非药物研究，相关性低。

42438973.title: Extracellular vesicles in senescence-associated chronic lung diseases.
42438973.what: 综述细胞外囊泡在慢性肺病衰老中的作用，并探讨治疗应用。
42438973.why: 囊泡递送抗衰老药物为新兴方向，但尚处早期。

42635645.title: Formononetin attenuates cellular senescence through a FOS-mediated mechanism.
42635645.what: 发现植物成分芒柄花素可让衰老细胞重新增殖，恢复线粒体功能。
42635645.why: 具有抗衰老药物潜力，机制新颖，值得关注。

42473972.title: Engineering biomaterial-mediated delivery for osteoarthritis: targeting aging mechanisms to reestablish joint homeostasis.
42473972.what: 综述生物材料靶向衰老机制治疗骨关节炎，实现局部给药。
42473972.why: 骨关节炎与衰老相关，递送系统增强药效，临床价值。

42269275.title: Fingolimod induces cytotoxic stress and apoptosis-like cell death in drug-sensitive and P-glycoprotein-overexpressing acute myeloid leukemia cells.
42269275.what: 研究药物芬戈莫德对白血病细胞的杀伤作用，与衰老无关。

42607216.title: CXCR4-targeted dual softener for inducing senescence therapy in hepatic fibrosis.
42607216.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
42607216.what: 开发靶向肝星状细胞的纳米颗粒诱导衰老，治疗肝纤维化。
42607216.why: 抗衰老策略用于肝病，创新递送平台，有临床潜力。

42546696.title: The BAX/BAK apoptotic checkpoint polices entry to therapy-induced senescence.
42546696.what: 发现BAX/BAK蛋白控制细胞进入衰老的检查点，基因缺失增强衰老。
42546696.why: 理解衰老调控机制，但非直接药物，基础研究。

42627547.title: Icaritin improves pregnancy outcomes in endometriosis by inhibiting ovarian granulosa cell senescence.
42627547.what: 中药淫羊藿次苷可抑制卵巢颗粒细胞衰老，改善子宫内膜异位症生育。
42627547.why: 植物药改善生育与抗衰老，具应用前景。

42641619.title: Molecular targets in proliferative vitreoretinopathy: rethinking prevention, treatment and drug delivery after rhegmatogenous retinal detachment.
42641619.what: 综述增殖性玻璃体视网膜病变的药物靶点和递送挑战。
42641619.why: 眼科衰老相关病，但重点在预防治疗，非抗衰老药。

42360689.title: TORC1 inactivation induces a noncanonical, separase-independent cohesin degradation.
42360689.what: 研究酵母中TORC1失活导致染色体黏连蛋白降解机制。
42360689.why: 基础机制，不涉及药物或衰老干预。

42648451.title: Rapamycin attenuates age-related atrial remodeling and fibrillation by targeting HIF-1α-mediated metabolic dysregulation.
42648451.journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease
42648451.what: 雷帕霉素改善老年小鼠心房重构和房颤，机制涉及抑制HIF-1α。
42648451.why: 经典抗衰老药新适应症，动物实验证据，临床转化可能。

42644500.title: TCR Signal Strength and Duration In Primary Mouse CD8+ T Cell Activation and Differentiation: A Standardized In Vitro Approach.
42644500.what: 标准化体外激活T细胞的方法，研究信号强度和时长影响。
42644500.why: 免疫学方法学，与抗衰老无关。

42519061.title: TRF2 enriched cytoplasmic chromatin drives cGAS-STAT1-mediated inflammation in senescence.
42519061.what: 发现衰老细胞中端粒蛋白片段引发炎症，二甲双胍或JAK抑制剂可抑制。
42519061.why: 揭示衰老炎症机制，提供药物靶点，已有药可干预。
